transcript_only_text:
Here's  a  foolproof  plan  on  how  to  stay 
 poor.  One,  don't  start  until  everyone 
 says  it's  a  good  idea.  Two,  tolerate 
 mediocre  people.  Three,  do  what  your 
 poor  friends  do  and  then  expect  to  get 
 rich.  Four,  assume  that  anyone  who  makes 
 more  money  than  you  is  somehow 
 unethical.  Five,  think  that  you  need  to 
 start  rich  to  get  rich.  Six,  say,  "I'm 
 not  a  math  person."  and  then  forever 
 think  the  fact  that  you  had  a  bad  eighth 
 grade  math  teacher  excuses  you  from 
 learning  anything  new.  Most  people 
 already  know  what  to  do.  They're  just 
 hoping  there's  an  easier  answer  when 
 there  isn't  one.
